# Objetivo

Este notebook es el segundo EDA del frente QR vs BIP. El primer EDA describio
diferencias entre tarjetas/viajes QR y BIP y cerro con una lectura interanual.
Este segundo EDA se concentra solo en la pregunta de crecimiento zonal:

> Que zonas aumentan mas o menos su uso QR entre 2024 y 2025, y que variables
> territoriales parecen asociarse con esas diferencias?

El objetivo todavia no es estimar un modelo final. La meta es dejar bien
definida la unidad de analisis, el outcome, el soporte comparable y las
variables candidatas antes de pasar a regresion.

La lectura sigue siendo descriptiva. Las zonas no son personas, y las variables
residenciales, OSM u operacionales son atributos heredados desde zonas.

# 3) Helpers

```{python}
#| label: helpers
print("label: helpers")

def fmt_int(value):
    if pd.isna(value):
        return ""
    return f"{int(round(value)):,}".replace(",", ".")


def fmt_pp(value):
    if pd.isna(value):
        return ""
    return f"{value:+.2f}"


def fmt_pct(value):
    if pd.isna(value):
        return ""
    return f"{value:.1%}"


def style_table(df: pd.DataFrame, formatters: dict | None = None):
    return (
        df.style.format(formatters or {}, na_rep="")
        .hide(axis="index")
    )


FIG_BG = "#F7F2E8"
AX_BG = "#FBF8F0"
TEXT_COLOR = "#1F2933"
MUTED_TEXT = "#6F6A61"
GRID_COLOR = "#DED6C8"
NEUTRAL_LINE = "#B8B1A4"
PAYMENT_COLORS = {
    "BIP": "#1F5A7A",
    "QR": "#D76242",
}


def style_axis(ax, *, grid_axis: str = "y"):
    ax.set_facecolor(AX_BG)
    ax.grid(axis=grid_axis, color=GRID_COLOR, linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.75)
    ax.set_axisbelow(True)
    ax.tick_params(colors=TEXT_COLOR)
    for side in ["top", "right"]:
        ax.spines[side].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines["left"].set_color("#8E877A")
    ax.spines["bottom"].set_color("#8E877A")


def safe_logit_from_counts(n_qr: pd.Series, n_total: pd.Series, alpha: float = 0.5) -> pd.Series:
    """Logit suavizado para shares 0/1 sin infinitos."""
    successes = n_qr.astype(float) + alpha
    failures = (n_total.astype(float) - n_qr.astype(float)) + alpha
    return np.log(successes / failures)


def weighted_corr(x: pd.Series, y: pd.Series, w: pd.Series) -> float:
    valid = x.notna() & y.notna() & w.notna() & w.gt(0)
    if valid.sum() < 3:
        return np.nan
    xv = x.loc[valid].astype(float).to_numpy()
    yv = y.loc[valid].astype(float).to_numpy()
    wv = w.loc[valid].astype(float).to_numpy()
    x_mean = np.average(xv, weights=wv)
    y_mean = np.average(yv, weights=wv)
    cov = np.average((xv - x_mean) * (yv - y_mean), weights=wv)
    x_var = np.average((xv - x_mean) ** 2, weights=wv)
    y_var = np.average((yv - y_mean) ** 2, weights=wv)
    if x_var <= 0 or y_var <= 0:
        return np.nan
    return float(cov / np.sqrt(x_var * y_var))


def load_zona777_geometries(path: Path = ZONAS777_SHP) -> gpd.GeoDataFrame:
    gdf = gpd.read_file(path)
    if "ZONA777" not in gdf.columns:
        raise ValueError(f"El shapefile no contiene columna ZONA777: {path}")

    keep_cols = [
        col
        for col in ["ZONA777", "NMACROZONA", "MACROZONA", "COMUNA", "geometry"]
        if col in gdf.columns
    ]
    gdf = gdf[keep_cols].copy()
    gdf["zone_id"] = pd.to_numeric(gdf["ZONA777"], errors="coerce")
    gdf = gdf.dropna(subset=["zone_id"]).copy()
    gdf["zone_id"] = gdf["zone_id"].astype("int64")
    if gdf.crs is None:
        gdf = gdf.set_crs("EPSG:32719", allow_override=True)
    return gdf.dissolve(by="zone_id", as_index=False)
```

# 4) Bloque 1 - Definicion del outcome zonal

La primera decision del segundo EDA es metodologica: antes de cruzar variables
explicativas, hay que fijar que significa que una zona "crece" en QR. Hay al
menos dos geografias distintas:

- **Residencia**: tarjetas QR o BIP del ano agrupadas por `zona_hogar`.
- **Origen de viaje**: viajes iniciados en cada zona.

Estas geografias no responden la misma pregunta. Residencia describe la
composicion de tarjetas asociadas a una zona residencial estimada. Origen de
viaje describe donde se usa el sistema en terminos transaccionales.

## 4.2 Construccion de tabla zonal base

```{python}
#| label: block1b-build-zone-panel
print("label: block1b-build-zone-panel")


def interannual_trip_lazyframe(paths: list[Path]) -> pl.LazyFrame:
    scans = [
        pl.scan_parquet(path).select(
            [
                pl.col("id_tarjeta").cast(pl.Utf8).alias("id_tarjeta"),
                pl.col("fecha").dt.year().cast(pl.Int16).alias("year"),
                pl.col("zona_inicio_viaje")
                .cast(pl.Int64, strict=False)
                .alias("origin_zone_id"),
                pl.col("is_qr").cast(pl.Int8).alias("is_qr_trip"),
            ]
        )
        for path in paths
    ]
    if not scans:
        raise FileNotFoundError("No hay parquets de viajes interanuales.")
    return (
        pl.concat(scans, how="diagonal_relaxed")
        .filter(pl.col("year").is_in(INTERANNUAL_YEARS))
    )


def payment_consistency_by_card_year(trips_lf: pl.LazyFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Chequeo: las tarjetas deberian observarse como QR o BIP, no ambas."""
    out = (
        trips_lf.group_by(["id_tarjeta", "year"])
        .agg(
            [
                pl.len().alias("n_trips"),
                pl.col("is_qr_trip").n_unique().alias("n_payment_values"),
            ]
        )
        .group_by("year")
        .agg(
            [
                pl.len().alias("n_card_years"),
                (pl.col("n_payment_values") > 1).sum().alias("n_inconsistent_card_years"),
                pl.col("n_trips").sum().alias("n_trips"),
            ]
        )
        .sort("year")
        .collect()
        .to_pandas()
    )
    out["share_inconsistent_card_years"] = (
        out["n_inconsistent_card_years"] / out["n_card_years"]
    )
    return out


def interannual_wide_zone_rates(
    long_df: pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    geography_key: str,
    geography: str,
    unit: str,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    frames = []
    for year in INTERANNUAL_YEARS:
        year_df = (
            long_df.loc[
                long_df["year"].eq(year),
                ["zone_id", "n_obs", "n_qr", "qr_share"],
            ]
            .copy()
            .rename(
                columns={
                    "n_obs": f"n_{year}",
                    "n_qr": f"n_qr_{year}",
                    "qr_share": f"qr_share_{year}",
                }
            )
        )
        frames.append(year_df)

    wide = frames[0].merge(
        frames[1],
        on="zone_id",
        how="outer",
        validate="one_to_one",
    )
    for year in INTERANNUAL_YEARS:
        for col in [f"n_{year}", f"n_qr_{year}"]:
            wide[col] = wide[col].fillna(0).astype("int64")

    wide["support_min"] = wide[[f"n_{year}" for year in INTERANNUAL_YEARS]].min(axis=1)
    wide["geography_key"] = geography_key
    wide["geography"] = geography
    wide["unit"] = unit
    return wide.sort_values("zone_id").reset_index(drop=True)


def interannual_card_year_residence_rates(
    trips_lf: pl.LazyFrame,
    cards_lf: pl.LazyFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    residence_universe = (
        cards_lf.select(
            [
                pl.col("id_tarjeta").cast(pl.Utf8).alias("id_tarjeta"),
                pl.col("zona_hogar").cast(pl.Int64, strict=False).alias("zone_id"),
            ]
        )
        .filter(pl.col("zone_id").is_not_null())
    )

    card_year = (
        trips_lf.join(residence_universe, on="id_tarjeta", how="inner")
        .group_by(["id_tarjeta", "year", "zone_id"])
        .agg(
            [
                pl.len().alias("n_trips_year"),
                pl.col("is_qr_trip").first().alias("is_qr_year"),
                pl.col("is_qr_trip").n_unique().alias("n_payment_values"),
            ]
        )
        .filter(pl.col("n_payment_values") == 1)
    )

    rates = (
        card_year.group_by(["zone_id", "year"])
        .agg(
            [
                pl.len().alias("n_obs"),
                pl.col("is_qr_year").sum().alias("n_qr"),
                pl.col("is_qr_year").mean().alias("qr_share"),
            ]
        )
        .collect()
        .to_pandas()
    )
    return interannual_wide_zone_rates(
        rates,
        geography_key="residence",
        geography="Residencia",
        unit="tarjetas QR o BIP del ano",
    )


def interannual_trip_origin_rates(trips_lf: pl.LazyFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    rates = (
        trips_lf.filter(
            pl.col("origin_zone_id").is_not_null()
            & (pl.col("origin_zone_id") > 0)
        )
        .group_by(["origin_zone_id", "year"])
        .agg(
            [
                pl.len().alias("n_obs"),
                pl.col("is_qr_trip").sum().alias("n_qr"),
                pl.col("is_qr_trip").mean().alias("qr_share"),
            ]
        )
        .rename({"origin_zone_id": "zone_id"})
        .collect()
        .to_pandas()
    )
    return interannual_wide_zone_rates(
        rates,
        geography_key="origin_trip",
        geography="Origen de viaje",
        unit="viajes iniciados en la zona",
    )


def add_outcome_candidates(frame: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    out = frame.copy()

    total_2024 = out["n_2024"].sum()
    total_2025 = out["n_2025"].sum()
    global_2024 = out["n_qr_2024"].sum() / total_2024 if total_2024 > 0 else np.nan
    global_2025 = out["n_qr_2025"].sum() / total_2025 if total_2025 > 0 else np.nan
    global_delta_pp = (global_2025 - global_2024) * 100

    out["global_qr_share_2024"] = global_2024
    out["global_qr_share_2025"] = global_2025
    out["global_delta_pp"] = global_delta_pp
    out["delta_pp"] = (out["qr_share_2025"] - out["qr_share_2024"]) * 100
    out["delta_relative_pp"] = out["delta_pp"] - global_delta_pp
    out["qr_count_delta"] = out["n_qr_2025"] - out["n_qr_2024"]
    out["total_count_delta"] = out["n_2025"] - out["n_2024"]
    out["share_shift_qr_delta"] = (
        out["qr_share_2025"] - out["qr_share_2024"]
    ) * out["n_2025"]
    out["volume_qr_delta"] = out["qr_share_2024"] * (
        out["n_2025"] - out["n_2024"]
    )
    out["logit_qr_share_2024_smooth"] = safe_logit_from_counts(
        out["n_qr_2024"], out["n_2024"]
    )
    out["logit_qr_share_2025_smooth"] = safe_logit_from_counts(
        out["n_qr_2025"], out["n_2025"]
    )
    out["delta_logit_qr_share_smooth"] = (
        out["logit_qr_share_2025_smooth"]
        - out["logit_qr_share_2024_smooth"]
    )
    return out


interannual_trips_lf = interannual_trip_lazyframe(TRIP_PATHS)
payment_consistency = payment_consistency_by_card_year(interannual_trips_lf)

zone_panel = pd.concat(
    [
        add_outcome_candidates(
            interannual_card_year_residence_rates(interannual_trips_lf, lf_cards)
        ),
        add_outcome_candidates(interannual_trip_origin_rates(interannual_trips_lf)),
    ],
    ignore_index=True,
)

display(
    style_table(
        payment_consistency,
        {
            "n_card_years": fmt_int,
            "n_inconsistent_card_years": fmt_int,
            "n_trips": fmt_int,
            "share_inconsistent_card_years": fmt_pct,
        },
    )
)

display(zone_panel.head())
```

## 4.3 Chequeo de soporte comparable

```{python}
#| label: block1c-support-summary
print("label: block1c-support-summary")


def support_summary(zone_df: pd.DataFrame, thresholds: list[int]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    rows = []
    for geography, g in zone_df.groupby("geography", sort=False):
        for threshold in thresholds:
            supported = g.loc[
                g["support_min"].ge(threshold)
                & g["delta_pp"].notna()
            ].copy()
            rows.append(
                {
                    "geography": geography,
                    "min_support_per_year": threshold,
                    "n_supported_zones": len(supported),
                    "total_obs_2024": int(g["n_2024"].sum()),
                    "total_obs_2025": int(g["n_2025"].sum()),
                    "supported_obs_2024": int(supported["n_2024"].sum()),
                    "supported_obs_2025": int(supported["n_2025"].sum()),
                    "global_qr_share_2024": g["global_qr_share_2024"].iloc[0],
                    "global_qr_share_2025": g["global_qr_share_2025"].iloc[0],
                    "global_delta_pp": g["global_delta_pp"].iloc[0],
                    "median_delta_pp": supported["delta_pp"].median(),
                    "p10_delta_pp": supported["delta_pp"].quantile(0.10),
                    "p90_delta_pp": supported["delta_pp"].quantile(0.90),
                    "share_positive_delta": supported["delta_pp"].gt(0).mean(),
                    "median_delta_relative_pp": supported["delta_relative_pp"].median(),
                    "share_above_global_growth": supported["delta_relative_pp"].gt(0).mean(),
                }
            )
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


block1_support_summary = support_summary(zone_panel, SUPPORT_THRESHOLDS)

display(
    style_table(
        block1_support_summary,
        {
            "min_support_per_year": fmt_int,
            "n_supported_zones": fmt_int,
            "total_obs_2024": fmt_int,
            "total_obs_2025": fmt_int,
            "supported_obs_2024": fmt_int,
            "supported_obs_2025": fmt_int,
            "global_qr_share_2024": fmt_pct,
            "global_qr_share_2025": fmt_pct,
            "global_delta_pp": fmt_pp,
            "median_delta_pp": fmt_pp,
            "p10_delta_pp": fmt_pp,
            "p90_delta_pp": fmt_pp,
            "share_positive_delta": fmt_pct,
            "median_delta_relative_pp": fmt_pp,
            "share_above_global_growth": fmt_pct,
        },
    )
)
```

**Lectura esperada.** Si los resultados principales cambian mucho entre
umbrales de soporte, el outcome zonal es fragil. Si se mantienen, podemos usar
`>=250` como umbral base y dejar `>=100`/`>=500` como sensibilidad.

```{python}
#| label: block1e-outcome-summary
print("label: block1e-outcome-summary")


OUTCOME_COLUMNS = [
    "delta_pp",
    "delta_relative_pp",
    "delta_logit_qr_share_smooth",
    "share_shift_qr_delta",
    "qr_count_delta",
]


def outcome_distribution_summary(
    zone_df: pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    min_support: int = BASE_MIN_SUPPORT,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    rows = []
    for geography, g in zone_df.groupby("geography", sort=False):
        supported = g.loc[
            g["support_min"].ge(min_support)
            & g["delta_pp"].notna()
        ].copy()
        for col in OUTCOME_COLUMNS:
            s = supported[col].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).dropna()
            rows.append(
                {
                    "geography": geography,
                    "outcome": col,
                    "min_support_per_year": min_support,
                    "n_zones": len(s),
                    "mean": s.mean(),
                    "median": s.median(),
                    "p10": s.quantile(0.10),
                    "p90": s.quantile(0.90),
                    "share_positive": s.gt(0).mean(),
                }
            )
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


def outcome_correlation_summary(
    zone_df: pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    min_support: int = BASE_MIN_SUPPORT,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    rows = []
    for geography, g in zone_df.groupby("geography", sort=False):
        supported = g.loc[
            g["support_min"].ge(min_support)
            & g["delta_pp"].notna()
        ].copy()
        corr = supported[OUTCOME_COLUMNS].corr(method="spearman")
        for left in OUTCOME_COLUMNS:
            for right in OUTCOME_COLUMNS:
                if left >= right:
                    continue
                rows.append(
                    {
                        "geography": geography,
                        "outcome_a": left,
                        "outcome_b": right,
                        "spearman_corr": corr.loc[left, right],
                    }
                )
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


block1_outcome_distribution = outcome_distribution_summary(zone_panel)
block1_outcome_correlations = outcome_correlation_summary(zone_panel)

display(
    style_table(
        block1_outcome_distribution,
        {
            "min_support_per_year": fmt_int,
            "n_zones": fmt_int,
            "mean": "{:+.2f}",
            "median": "{:+.2f}",
            "p10": "{:+.2f}",
            "p90": "{:+.2f}",
            "share_positive": fmt_pct,
        },
    )
)

display(
    style_table(
        block1_outcome_correlations,
        {"spearman_corr": "{:+.2f}"},
    )
)
```

## 4.5 Cierre del bloque 1

El bloque deja tres conclusiones metodologicas para el resto del EDA. Primero,
el crecimiento QR es muy generalizado: con el umbral base de `>=250`
observaciones por año, casi todas las zonas comparables aumentan su share QR
entre 2024 y 2025. Esto hace que el delta bruto sea util para comunicar el
cambio, pero insuficiente para distinguir que zonas crecieron mas o menos que
la tendencia general.

Segundo, `>=250` observaciones por año queda como umbral base razonable. En
residencia conserva 627 zonas y casi todo el volumen observado; en origen de
viaje conserva 793 zonas y practicamente todo el volumen. Los umbrales `>=100`
y `>=500` se mantienen como sensibilidad, no como definiciones principales.

Tercero, el EDA debe separar outcomes de tasa y outcomes de volumen. Para
patrones territoriales, el outcome principal sera `delta_relative_pp`, porque
ordena las zonas segun crecimiento sobre/bajo la tendencia global de su
geografia. `delta_pp` se conserva como lectura directa. Para aporte agregado,
el outcome complementario sera `share_shift_qr_delta`, porque aproxima cuantos
QR equivalentes se asocian al cambio de share manteniendo fijo el volumen 2025.

`delta_logit_qr_share_smooth` queda como alternativa tecnica para una eventual
regresion lineal sobre proporciones. No reemplaza la lectura en puntos
porcentuales porque es menos comunicable. `qr_count_delta` queda como metrica
secundaria de volumen, ya que mezcla cambio en adopcion QR con cambios en el
volumen total observado.

**Decision para los siguientes bloques.** Cuando el objetivo sea entender
diferencias territoriales de crecimiento, usar `delta_relative_pp`. Cuando el
objetivo sea dimensionar aporte agregado, usar `share_shift_qr_delta`. No
mezclar ambas preguntas en una misma lectura: una zona puede crecer mucho en
tasa y aportar poco volumen, o aportar mucho volumen sin estar entre las zonas
de mayor crecimiento relativo.

# 5) Bloque 2 - Anatomia del cambio QR

Este bloque mira la forma del cambio antes de cruzarlo con variables
explicativas. La pregunta es descriptiva: si QR crece en casi todas las zonas,
cuanta dispersion queda entre zonas, que tan persistente es la geografia de
2024, y donde se ubican espacialmente las zonas que crecen sobre o bajo la
tendencia global.

La unidad sigue siendo la definida en el bloque 1. Se usa `>=250`
observaciones por año como soporte base.

## 5.1 Resumen del cambio zonal

**Lectura.** Esta tabla separa la lectura en dos niveles. `delta_pp_median`
muestra cuanto sube la zona mediana. `delta_relative_pp_median` muestra si la
zona mediana queda sobre o bajo el crecimiento global de su geografia. Si la
mediana relativa es negativa, no significa que QR disminuya; significa que la
zona mediana crece algo menos que el promedio global. Las columnas
`mean_zone_qr_share_2024` y `mean_zone_qr_share_2025` son medias simples entre
zonas; no son el share QR global ponderado por volumen.

## 5.2 Distribucion del cambio bruto y relativo

```{python}
#| label: block2b-change-distributions

def plot_block2_change_distributions(df: pd.DataFrame) -> None:
```

## 5.3 Persistencia 2024-2025 y refuerzo del nivel inicial

```{python}
#| label: block2c-persistence-and-relative-growth
print("label: block2c-persistence-and-relative-growth")


def block2_persistence_summary(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    rows = []
    for geography, g in df.groupby("geography", sort=False):
        w = g["support_min"].astype(float)
        rows.append(
            {
                "geography": geography,
                "n_zones": len(g),
                "corr_2024_2025_weighted": weighted_corr(
                    g["qr_share_2024"], g["qr_share_2025"], w
                ),
                "corr_2024_delta_relative_weighted": weighted_corr(
                    g["qr_share_2024"], g["delta_relative_pp"], w
                ),
                "share_above_global_growth": g["delta_relative_pp"].gt(0).mean(),
                "median_delta_relative_pp": g["delta_relative_pp"].median(),
            }
        )
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


def plot_block2_persistence(df: pd.DataFrame, summary_df: pd.DataFrame) -> None:
    geographies = list(df["geography"].drop_duplicates())
    all_rel = df["delta_relative_pp"].abs().replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).dropna()
    rel_abs = max(1.0, float(all_rel.quantile(0.98)))
    cmap = LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list(
        "delta_relative_qr",
        [PAYMENT_COLORS["BIP"], AX_BG, PAYMENT_COLORS["QR"]],
    )
    norm = TwoSlopeNorm(vmin=-rel_abs, vcenter=0, vmax=rel_abs)
    summary_lookup = summary_df.set_index("geography").to_dict("index")

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(
        len(geographies),
        2,
        figsize=(14.5, 4.8 * len(geographies)),
        facecolor=FIG_BG,
    )
    if len(geographies) == 1:
        axes = np.array([axes])

    for row_idx, geography in enumerate(geographies):
        g = df.loc[df["geography"].eq(geography)].copy()
        summary = summary_lookup[geography]
        sizes = 12 + 35 * (
            np.log1p(g["support_min"].astype(float))
            / np.log1p(g["support_min"].max())
        )
        colors = g["delta_relative_pp"].astype(float)

        ax = axes[row_idx, 0]
        ax.scatter(
            g["qr_share_2024"],
            g["qr_share_2025"],
            c=colors,
            cmap=cmap,
            norm=norm,
            s=sizes,
            alpha=0.72,
            edgecolor="white",
            linewidth=0.35,
        )
        x_min = max(0, min(g["qr_share_2024"].min(), g["qr_share_2025"].min()) - 0.02)
        x_max = min(0.40, max(g["qr_share_2024"].max(), g["qr_share_2025"].max()) + 0.02)
        global_delta = float(g["global_delta_pp"].iloc[0]) / 100
        xx = np.linspace(x_min, x_max, 100)
        ax.plot(xx, xx, color=NEUTRAL_LINE, linewidth=1.0, label="sin cambio")
        ax.plot(
            xx,
            xx + global_delta,
            color=MUTED_TEXT,
            linestyle="--",
            linewidth=1.2,
            label="mismo aumento que global",
        )
        ax.set_xlim(x_min, x_max)
        ax.set_ylim(x_min, min(0.42, x_max + global_delta + 0.02))
        ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(PercentFormatter(1.0))
        ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(PercentFormatter(1.0))
        ax.set_xlabel("Share QR 2024")
        ax.set_ylabel("Share QR 2025")
        ax.set_title(
            f"{geography} | Persistencia del nivel QR\ncorr ponderada = {summary['corr_2024_2025_weighted']:.2f}",
            loc="left",
            fontsize=11.5,
            fontweight="bold",
            color=TEXT_COLOR,
        )
        style_axis(ax, grid_axis="both")

        ax = axes[row_idx, 1]
        ax.scatter(
            g["qr_share_2024"],
            g["delta_relative_pp"],
            c=colors,
            cmap=cmap,
            norm=norm,
            s=sizes,
            alpha=0.72,
            edgecolor="white",
            linewidth=0.35,
        )
        fit = np.polyfit(
            g["qr_share_2024"].astype(float).to_numpy(),
            g["delta_relative_pp"].astype(float).to_numpy(),
            deg=1,
            w=np.sqrt(g["support_min"].astype(float).to_numpy()),
        )
        xx = np.linspace(g["qr_share_2024"].min(), g["qr_share_2024"].max(), 100)
        ax.plot(xx, fit[0] * xx + fit[1], color=TEXT_COLOR, linewidth=1.4, alpha=0.82)
        ax.axhline(0, color=MUTED_TEXT, linestyle="--", linewidth=1.1)
        ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(PercentFormatter(1.0))
        ax.set_xlabel("Share QR 2024")
        ax.set_ylabel("Delta zonal - delta global (pp)")
        ax.set_title(
            f"{geography} | Crecimiento relativo vs nivel inicial\ncorr ponderada = {summary['corr_2024_delta_relative_weighted']:.2f}",
            loc="left",
            fontsize=11.5,
            fontweight="bold",
            color=TEXT_COLOR,
        )
        style_axis(ax, grid_axis="both")

    handles = [
        plt.Line2D([0], [0], color=NEUTRAL_LINE, linewidth=1.0, label="sin cambio"),
        plt.Line2D([0], [0], color=MUTED_TEXT, linestyle="--", linewidth=1.2, label="mismo aumento que global"),
    ]
    fig.legend(handles=handles, loc="lower center", frameon=False, ncol=2, fontsize=9.5)
    fig.suptitle(
        "Persistencia espacial y crecimiento relativo QR",
        fontsize=17,
        fontweight="bold",
        color=TEXT_COLOR,
        y=0.99,
    )
    fig.text(
        0.5,
        0.945,
        "Color = delta zonal - delta global; tamaño = soporte minimo 2024/2025.",
        ha="center",
        va="center",
        fontsize=10.5,
        color=MUTED_TEXT,
    )
    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.07, right=0.98, top=0.88, bottom=0.10, hspace=0.36, wspace=0.22)
    plt.show()


block2_persistence = block2_persistence_summary(supported_zone_panel)
```

**Lectura del bloque 2.** El cambio QR es amplio y positivo en terminos
brutos, pero el crecimiento relativo no se distribuye de manera uniforme. La
persistencia 2024-2025 indica que la geografia previa importa: las zonas no se
reordenan completamente de un año a otro. Para los siguientes bloques, esto
significa que las variables candidatas deben evaluarse contra
`delta_relative_pp`, pero tambien considerando el nivel inicial 2024 y el
soporte/volumen de cada zona.

# 6) Bloque 3 - Volumen versus tasa

El bloque 2 muestra que casi todas las zonas aumentan su share QR, pero que no
todas crecen igual contra la tendencia global. Este bloque cambia la pregunta:
que zonas o macrozonas explican mas del aumento agregado.

La distincion es importante para el modelo posterior. Si cada zona pesa igual,
una zona chica con alto crecimiento relativo puede influir tanto como una zona
grande. Si el objetivo es explicar contribucion agregada, el volumen debe
entrar explicitamente.

Usaremos tres medidas:

- `delta_relative_pp`: crecimiento de la zona sobre/bajo la tendencia global.
- `share_shift_qr_delta`: QR equivalentes asociados al cambio de share,
  fijando el volumen 2025.
- `volume_qr_delta`: componente asociado al cambio de volumen total observado,
  manteniendo el share QR 2024.

## 6.1 Panel de contribucion por zona

```{python}
#| label: block3a-volume-contribution-panel
print("label: block3a-volume-contribution-panel")

BLOCK3_MAJOR_MACROZONES = [
    "Centro",
    "Oriente",
    "Norte",
    "Poniente",
    "Sur",
    "Suroriente",
]
BLOCK3_MACROZONE_ORDER = [*BLOCK3_MAJOR_MACROZONES, "Otras/externas"]
BLOCK3_GROWTH_ORDER = ["Bottom 20%", "Middle 60%", "Top 20%"]


def clean_block3_macrozone(value: object) -> str:
    if pd.isna(value):
        return "Sin macrozona"
    label = str(value).strip()
    if not label:
        return "Sin macrozona"
    return label.title()


def signed_int_label(value: float) -> str:
    if pd.isna(value):
        return ""
    sign = "+" if value >= 0 else "-"
    return f"{sign}{fmt_int(abs(int(round(value))))}"


def signed_axis_int(value: float, _pos=None) -> str:
    sign = "-" if value < 0 else ""
    return f"{sign}{fmt_int(abs(int(round(value))))}"


def assign_block3_growth_group(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    min_support: int = BASE_MIN_SUPPORT,
) -> pd.Series:
    labels = pd.Series("Sin soporte comparable", index=df.index, dtype="object")
    for _, group in df.groupby("geography_key", sort=False):
        supported = (
            group["support_min"].ge(min_support)
            & group["delta_relative_pp"].notna()
            & group["delta_pp"].notna()
        )
        idx = group.loc[supported].index
        if len(idx) < 5:
            continue
        ranks = group.loc[idx, "delta_relative_pp"].rank(method="first")
        quintile = pd.qcut(ranks, q=5, labels=range(1, 6)).astype(int)
        labels.loc[idx] = np.select(
            [quintile.eq(1), quintile.eq(5)],
            ["Bottom 20%", "Top 20%"],
            default="Middle 60%",
        )
    return labels


def build_block3_zone_contribution_panel(
    zone_df: pd.DataFrame,
    geometries: gpd.GeoDataFrame,
    *,
    min_support: int = BASE_MIN_SUPPORT,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    metadata_cols = [
        col
        for col in ["zone_id", "COMUNA", "MACROZONA", "NMACROZONA"]
        if col in geometries.columns
    ]
    metadata = geometries[metadata_cols].drop_duplicates("zone_id").copy()

    data = zone_df.merge(metadata, on="zone_id", how="left").copy()
    data = data.loc[
        data["qr_share_2024"].notna()
        & data["qr_share_2025"].notna()
        & data["n_2024"].gt(0)
        & data["n_2025"].gt(0)
    ].copy()

    macro_source = (
        data["MACROZONA"]
        if "MACROZONA" in data.columns
        else pd.Series(np.nan, index=data.index)
    )
    if "NMACROZONA" in data.columns:
        macro_source = macro_source.fillna(data["NMACROZONA"])
    data["macrozone"] = macro_source.apply(clean_block3_macrozone)
    data["macrozone_group"] = np.where(
        data["macrozone"].isin(BLOCK3_MAJOR_MACROZONES),
        data["macrozone"],
        "Otras/externas",
    )
    data["has_delta_support"] = (
        data["support_min"].ge(min_support)
        & data["delta_pp"].notna()
        & data["delta_relative_pp"].notna()
    )
    data["growth_group"] = assign_block3_growth_group(
        data,
        min_support=min_support,
    )

    data["qr_count_delta"] = data["n_qr_2025"] - data["n_qr_2024"]
    data["share_shift_qr_delta"] = (
        data["qr_share_2025"] - data["qr_share_2024"]
    ) * data["n_2025"]
    data["volume_qr_delta"] = data["qr_share_2024"] * (
        data["n_2025"] - data["n_2024"]
    )
    data["decomposition_residual"] = (
        data["qr_count_delta"]
        - data["share_shift_qr_delta"]
        - data["volume_qr_delta"]
    )

    data["macrozone_order"] = data["macrozone_group"].map(
        {label: idx for idx, label in enumerate(BLOCK3_MACROZONE_ORDER)}
    ).fillna(99)
    data["growth_order"] = data["growth_group"].map(
        {label: idx for idx, label in enumerate(BLOCK3_GROWTH_ORDER)}
    ).fillna(99)
    return data.sort_values(
        ["geography_key", "macrozone_order", "zone_id"]
    ).reset_index(drop=True)


def summarize_block3_decomposition(zone_contrib: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    out = (
        zone_contrib
        .groupby(["geography_key", "geography"], sort=False)
        .agg(
            n_zones=("zone_id", "size"),
            n_supported_delta_zones=("has_delta_support", "sum"),
            qr_count_delta=("qr_count_delta", "sum"),
            share_shift_qr_delta=("share_shift_qr_delta", "sum"),
            volume_qr_delta=("volume_qr_delta", "sum"),
            decomposition_residual=("decomposition_residual", "sum"),
        )
        .reset_index()
    )
    out["share_shift_share_of_net"] = np.where(
        out["qr_count_delta"].ne(0),
        out["share_shift_qr_delta"] / out["qr_count_delta"],
        np.nan,
    )
    out["volume_share_of_net"] = np.where(
        out["qr_count_delta"].ne(0),
        out["volume_qr_delta"] / out["qr_count_delta"],
        np.nan,
    )
    return out


if "zona777_geometries" not in globals():
    zona777_geometries = load_zona777_geometries()

block3_zone_contrib = build_block3_zone_contribution_panel(
    zone_panel,
    zona777_geometries,
)
block3_decomposition_summary = summarize_block3_decomposition(block3_zone_contrib)

display(
    style_table(
        block3_decomposition_summary[
            [
                "geography",
                "n_zones",
                "n_supported_delta_zones",
                "qr_count_delta",
                "share_shift_qr_delta",
                "volume_qr_delta",
                "decomposition_residual",
                "share_shift_share_of_net",
                "volume_share_of_net",
            ]
        ],
        {
            "n_zones": fmt_int,
            "n_supported_delta_zones": fmt_int,
            "qr_count_delta": signed_int_label,
            "share_shift_qr_delta": signed_int_label,
            "volume_qr_delta": signed_int_label,
            "decomposition_residual": signed_int_label,
            "share_shift_share_of_net": fmt_pct,
            "volume_share_of_net": fmt_pct,
        },
    )
)
```

**Como leer.** `qr_count_delta` es el cambio neto observado en QR. Se separa en
un componente por cambio de share (`share_shift_qr_delta`) y un componente por
cambio de volumen total (`volume_qr_delta`). Si el componente de volumen es
negativo, significa que el volumen total observado baja entre ventanas; aun
asi, QR puede aumentar si el share QR sube lo suficiente.

## 6.2 Contribucion por macrozona

```{python}
#| label: block3b-macrozone-volume-contribution
print("label: block3b-macrozone-volume-contribution")


def summarize_block3_contribution(
    zone_contrib: pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    group_col: str,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    grouped = (
        zone_contrib
        .groupby(["geography_key", "geography", "unit", group_col], observed=True)
        .agg(
            n_zones=("zone_id", "size"),
            n_supported_delta_zones=("has_delta_support", "sum"),
            n_2024=("n_2024", "sum"),
            n_2025=("n_2025", "sum"),
            n_qr_2024=("n_qr_2024", "sum"),
            n_qr_2025=("n_qr_2025", "sum"),
            qr_count_delta=("qr_count_delta", "sum"),
            share_shift_qr_delta=("share_shift_qr_delta", "sum"),
            volume_qr_delta=("volume_qr_delta", "sum"),
            median_delta_relative_pp=("delta_relative_pp", "median"),
        )
        .reset_index()
        .rename(columns={group_col: "group"})
    )
    grouped["qr_share_2024_group"] = grouped["n_qr_2024"] / grouped["n_2024"]
    grouped["qr_share_2025_group"] = grouped["n_qr_2025"] / grouped["n_2025"]
    grouped["group_delta_pp"] = (
        grouped["qr_share_2025_group"] - grouped["qr_share_2024_group"]
    ) * 100

    totals = (
        zone_contrib
        .groupby("geography_key", observed=True)
        .agg(
            total_qr_count_delta=("qr_count_delta", "sum"),
            total_share_shift_qr_delta=("share_shift_qr_delta", "sum"),
            total_volume_qr_delta=("volume_qr_delta", "sum"),
        )
        .reset_index()
    )
    out = grouped.merge(totals, on="geography_key", how="left", validate="many_to_one")
    out["share_of_qr_count_delta_total"] = np.where(
        out["total_qr_count_delta"].ne(0),
        out["qr_count_delta"] / out["total_qr_count_delta"],
        np.nan,
    )
    out["share_of_share_shift_total"] = np.where(
        out["total_share_shift_qr_delta"].ne(0),
        out["share_shift_qr_delta"] / out["total_share_shift_qr_delta"],
        np.nan,
    )
    out["geography_order"] = out["geography_key"].map(
        {"residence": 0, "origin_trip": 1}
    ).fillna(99)
    if group_col == "macrozone_group":
        out["group_order"] = out["group"].map(
            {label: idx for idx, label in enumerate(BLOCK3_MACROZONE_ORDER)}
        ).fillna(99)
    else:
        out["group_order"] = out["group"].map(
            {label: idx for idx, label in enumerate(BLOCK3_GROWTH_ORDER)}
        ).fillna(99)
    return out.sort_values(["geography_order", "group_order", "group"]).reset_index(drop=True)


def plot_block3_macrozone_share_contribution(summary_df: pd.DataFrame) -> None:
    geographies = (
        summary_df[["geography_order", "geography"]]
        .drop_duplicates()
        .sort_values("geography_order")["geography"]
        .tolist()
    )
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(
        1,
        len(geographies),
        figsize=(16.4, 5.6),
        facecolor=FIG_BG,
        sharex=False,
    )
    if len(geographies) == 1:
        axes = np.array([axes])

    for ax, geography in zip(axes, geographies):
        panel = (
            summary_df.loc[summary_df["geography"].eq(geography)]
            .sort_values("share_shift_qr_delta", ascending=True)
            .reset_index(drop=True)
        )
        y = np.arange(len(panel))
        values = panel["share_shift_qr_delta"].astype(float).to_numpy()
        colors = np.where(values >= 0, PAYMENT_COLORS["QR"], PAYMENT_COLORS["BIP"])
        x_abs = max(1.0, float(np.nanmax(np.abs(values))) * 1.30)

        ax.set_facecolor(AX_BG)
        ax.axvline(0, color=MUTED_TEXT, linewidth=1.0, alpha=0.72)
        ax.barh(y, values, color=colors, alpha=0.88, height=0.64)
        for y_pos, value, share in zip(y, values, panel["share_of_share_shift_total"]):
            label = f"{signed_int_label(value)} ({share:.1%})"
            offset = x_abs * 0.025 if value >= 0 else -x_abs * 0.025
            ax.text(
                value + offset,
                y_pos,
                label,
                ha="left" if value >= 0 else "right",
                va="center",
                fontsize=8.8,
                color=TEXT_COLOR,
            )

        ax.set_yticks(y)
        ax.set_yticklabels(panel["group"].tolist(), fontsize=9.3)
        ax.set_xlim(-x_abs if np.nanmin(values) < 0 else 0, x_abs)
        ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(FuncFormatter(signed_axis_int))
        ax.set_xlabel("QR equivalentes por cambio de share")
        total_share = panel["total_share_shift_qr_delta"].iloc[0]
        total_net = panel["total_qr_count_delta"].iloc[0]
        ax.set_title(
            (
                f"{geography}\n"
                f"Aporte share: {signed_int_label(total_share)} | "
                f"delta neto QR: {signed_int_label(total_net)}"
            ),
            loc="left",
            fontsize=11.4,
            fontweight="bold",
            color=TEXT_COLOR,
            pad=10,
        )
        style_axis(ax, grid_axis="x")

    fig.suptitle(
        "Contribucion volumetrica al aumento QR por macrozona",
        fontsize=16.5,
        fontweight="bold",
        color=TEXT_COLOR,
        y=0.985,
    )
    fig.text(
        0.5,
        0.925,
        "Barras = n_2025 * (share QR 2025 - share QR 2024). Etiquetas: aporte absoluto y porcentaje del total de su geografia.",
        ha="center",
        va="center",
        fontsize=10.0,
        color=MUTED_TEXT,
    )
    fig.text(
        0.5,
        0.025,
        "Nota: esta figura prioriza cambio de share; el componente por cambio de volumen total se reporta en la tabla.",
        ha="center",
        va="center",
        fontsize=8.8,
        color=MUTED_TEXT,
    )
    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.145, right=0.98, top=0.79, bottom=0.14, wspace=0.36)
    plt.show()


def plot_block3_share_volume_decomposition(summary_df: pd.DataFrame) -> None:
    geographies = (
        summary_df[["geography_order", "geography"]]
        .drop_duplicates()
        .sort_values("geography_order")["geography"]
        .tolist()
    )
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(
        1,
        len(geographies),
        figsize=(16.4, 5.4),
        facecolor=FIG_BG,
        sharex=False,
    )
    if len(geographies) == 1:
        axes = np.array([axes])

    for ax, geography in zip(axes, geographies):
        panel = (
            summary_df.loc[summary_df["geography"].eq(geography)]
            .sort_values("share_shift_qr_delta", ascending=True)
            .reset_index(drop=True)
        )
        y = np.arange(len(panel))
        share_values = panel["share_shift_qr_delta"].astype(float).to_numpy()
        volume_values = panel["volume_qr_delta"].astype(float).to_numpy()
        net_values = panel["qr_count_delta"].astype(float).to_numpy()
        x_abs = max(
            1.0,
            float(
                np.nanmax(
                    np.abs(np.concatenate([share_values, volume_values, net_values]))
                )
            ) * 1.30,
        )

        ax.set_facecolor(AX_BG)
        ax.axvline(0, color=MUTED_TEXT, linewidth=1.0, alpha=0.72)
        ax.barh(
            y - 0.18,
            share_values,
            color=PAYMENT_COLORS["QR"],
            alpha=0.86,
            height=0.28,
            label="Cambio de share QR",
        )
        ax.barh(
            y + 0.18,
            volume_values,
            color=PAYMENT_COLORS["BIP"],
            alpha=0.72,
            height=0.28,
            label="Cambio de volumen total",
        )
        ax.scatter(
            net_values,
            y,
            color=TEXT_COLOR,

            zorder=3,
            label="Delta neto QR",
        )
        ax.set_yticks(y)
        ax.set_yticklabels(panel["group"].tolist(), fontsize=9.3)
        ax.set_xlim(-x_abs, x_abs)
        ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(FuncFormatter(signed_axis_int))
        ax.set_xlabel("Observaciones QR")
        ax.set_title(
            geography,
            loc="left",
            fontsize=11.4,
            fontweight="bold",
            color=TEXT_COLOR,
            pad=10,
        )
        style_axis(ax, grid_axis="x")

    handles, labels = axes[0].get_legend_handles_labels()
    fig.legend(
        handles,
        labels,
        loc="lower center",
        ncol=3,
        frameon=False,
        fontsize=9.0,
        bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 0.02),
    )
    fig.suptitle(
        "Separacion entre cambio de share QR y cambio de volumen total",
        fontsize=16.5,
        fontweight="bold",
        color=TEXT_COLOR,
        y=0.985,
    )
    fig.text(
        0.5,
        0.925,
        "Barras naranjas: efecto de mayor share QR; barras azules: efecto de cambios en volumen total observado; punto: delta neto.",
        ha="center",
        va="center",
        fontsize=10.0,
        color=MUTED_TEXT,
    )
    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.145, right=0.98, top=0.79, bottom=0.16, wspace=0.36)
    plt.show()
```

**Como leer.** La primera figura responde que macrozonas aportan mas al aumento

## 6.3 Top zonas por aporte agregado

```{python}
#| label: block3c-top-zone-contribution
print("label: block3c-top-zone-contribution")


def top_block3_zone_contributors(
    zone_contrib: pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    n_each: int = 12,
    metric: str = "share_shift_qr_delta",
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    rows = []
    data = zone_contrib.loc[zone_contrib["has_delta_support"]].copy()
    for geography, group in data.groupby("geography", sort=False):
        top = group.nlargest(n_each, metric).copy()
        top["rank"] = range(1, len(top) + 1)
        rows.append(top)
    if not rows:
        return pd.DataFrame()
    out = pd.concat(rows, ignore_index=True)
    return out[
        [
            "geography",
            "rank",
            "zone_id",
            "COMUNA",
            "macrozone_group",
            "support_min",
            "n_2025",
            "qr_share_2024",
            "qr_share_2025",
            "delta_pp",
            "delta_relative_pp",
            "share_shift_qr_delta",
            "volume_qr_delta",
            "qr_count_delta",
        ]
    ].copy()

            "qr_share_2024": fmt_pct,
            "qr_share_2025": fmt_pct,
            "delta_pp": fmt_pp,
            "delta_relative_pp": fmt_pp,
            "share_shift_qr_delta": signed_int_label,
            "volume_qr_delta": signed_int_label,
            "qr_count_delta": signed_int_label,
        },
    )
)
```

**Como leer.** Estas son las zonas que mas aportan al aumento agregado por
cambio de share QR. No necesariamente son las zonas con mayor
`delta_relative_pp`; pueden aparecer porque tienen mucho volumen 2025.

## 6.4 Contraste entre aporte y crecimiento relativo

```{python}
#| label: block3d-relative-growth-vs-contribution
print("label: block3d-relative-growth-vs-contribution")


def build_block3_relative_vs_contribution(
    zone_contrib: pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    tail_share: float = 0.20,
) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    data = zone_contrib.loc[zone_contrib["has_delta_support"]].copy()
    data["contrast_group"] = "Resto"
    summary_rows = []

    for geography, group in data.groupby("geography", sort=False):
        n_tail = max(1, int(np.ceil(len(group) * tail_share)))
        top_relative_idx = group.nlargest(n_tail, "delta_relative_pp").index
        top_contrib_idx = group.nlargest(n_tail, "share_shift_qr_delta").index
        both_idx = top_relative_idx.intersection(top_contrib_idx)

        data.loc[top_relative_idx, "contrast_group"] = "Top crecimiento relativo"
        data.loc[top_contrib_idx, "contrast_group"] = "Top aporte share"
        data.loc[both_idx, "contrast_group"] = "Ambos"

        for label, idx in [
            ("Top crecimiento relativo", top_relative_idx),
            ("Top aporte share", top_contrib_idx),
            ("Ambos", both_idx),
        ]:
            subset = data.loc[idx]
            summary_rows.append(
                {
                    "geography": geography,
                    "group": label,
                    "n_zones": len(subset),
                    "median_delta_relative_pp": subset["delta_relative_pp"].median(),
                    "median_n_2025": subset["n_2025"].median(),
                    "share_shift_qr_delta": subset["share_shift_qr_delta"].sum(),
                    "share_of_supported_shift": (
                        subset["share_shift_qr_delta"].sum()
                        / group["share_shift_qr_delta"].sum()
                        if group["share_shift_qr_delta"].sum() != 0
                        else np.nan
                    ),
                    "median_qr_share_2024": subset["qr_share_2024"].median(),
                    "median_qr_share_2025": subset["qr_share_2025"].median(),
                }
            )

    summary = pd.DataFrame(summary_rows)
    return data, summary


def plot_block3_relative_vs_contribution(contrast_df: pd.DataFrame) -> None:
    geographies = list(contrast_df["geography"].drop_duplicates())
    colors = {
        "Resto": "#D8D0C3",
        "Top crecimiento relativo": PAYMENT_COLORS["BIP"],
        "Top aporte share": PAYMENT_COLORS["QR"],
        "Ambos": "#5B2C83",
    }
    order = ["Resto", "Top crecimiento relativo", "Top aporte share", "Ambos"]

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(
        1,
        len(geographies),
        figsize=(15.6, 5.4),
        facecolor=FIG_BG,
    )
    if len(geographies) == 1:
        axes = np.array([axes])

    for ax, geography in zip(axes, geographies):
        panel = contrast_df.loc[contrast_df["geography"].eq(geography)].copy()
        max_support = panel["n_2025"].max()
        for label in order:
            sub = panel.loc[panel["contrast_group"].eq(label)]
            if sub.empty:
                continue
            sizes = 14 + 60 * np.sqrt(sub["n_2025"].astype(float) / max_support)
            ax.scatter(
                sub["delta_relative_pp"],
                sub["share_shift_qr_delta"],
                s=sizes,
                color=colors[label],
                alpha=0.72 if label == "Resto" else 0.86,
                edgecolor="white",
                linewidth=0.35,
                label=label,
            )
        ax.axvline(0, color=MUTED_TEXT, linestyle="--", linewidth=1.0)
        ax.axhline(0, color=MUTED_TEXT, linewidth=1.0, alpha=0.7)
        ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(FuncFormatter(signed_axis_int))
        ax.set_xlabel("Delta zonal - global (pp)")
        ax.set_ylabel("QR equivalentes por cambio de share")
        ax.set_title(
            geography,
            loc="left",
            fontsize=11.4,
            fontweight="bold",
            color=TEXT_COLOR,
            pad=10,
        )
        style_axis(ax, grid_axis="both")

    handles, labels = axes[0].get_legend_handles_labels()
    fig.legend(
        handles,
        labels,
        loc="lower center",
        ncol=4,
        frameon=False,
        fontsize=9.0,
        bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 0.02),
    )
    fig.suptitle(
        "Crecimiento relativo versus aporte agregado",
        fontsize=16.5,
        fontweight="bold",
        color=TEXT_COLOR,
        y=0.985,
    )
    fig.text(
        0.5,
        0.925,
        "Eje X: tasa relativa; eje Y: contribucion agregada por cambio de share. Tamaño = volumen 2025.",
        ha="center",
        va="center",
        fontsize=10.0,
        color=MUTED_TEXT,
    )
    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.075, right=0.98, top=0.80, bottom=0.17, wspace=0.24)
    plt.show()


block3_contrast_panel, block3_contrast_summary = build_block3_relative_vs_contribution(
    block3_zone_contrib,
    tail_share=0.20,
)

display(
    style_table(
        block3_contrast_summary,
        {
            "n_zones": fmt_int,
            "median_delta_relative_pp": fmt_pp,
            "median_n_2025": fmt_int,
            "share_shift_qr_delta": signed_int_label,
            "share_of_supported_shift": fmt_pct,
            "median_qr_share_2024": fmt_pct,
            "median_qr_share_2025": fmt_pct,
        },
    )
)

plot_block3_relative_vs_contribution(block3_contrast_panel)
```

**Lectura esperada.** Si el top por crecimiento relativo y el top por aporte
agregado no coinciden, entonces una regresion sin pesos y una regresion
ponderada por soporte responderan preguntas distintas. La primera describe
heterogeneidad territorial entre zonas; la segunda se acerca mas al aporte
agregado del sistema.

**Cierre del bloque 3.** El aumento QR entre 2024 y 2025 se explica
principalmente por un aumento de participacion QR, no por un aumento del volumen
total observado. En origen de viaje, el cambio de share equivale a cerca de
`+1.765.393` viajes QR adicionales, pero el menor volumen total observado resta
aproximadamente `-413.939`; por eso el delta neto queda en `+1.351.454`. En
residencia ocurre lo mismo en menor escala: el componente de share suma cerca
de `+65.500` tarjetas QR equivalentes y el componente de volumen resta cerca
de `-4.599`.

La distribucion territorial depende de si se mira tasa o volumen. En residencia,
Poniente es el mayor aportante por cambio de share, seguido por Suroriente y
Oriente. En origen de viaje, Oriente concentra el mayor aporte, seguido por
Centro, Poniente y Suroriente. Esto matiza la lectura de crecimiento relativo:
una zona puede crecer mucho sobre la tendencia global y aportar poco al total
si tiene bajo volumen, mientras que una zona grande puede explicar mucho del
aumento agregado aun con un crecimiento relativo moderado.

El contraste top relativo versus top aporte confirma esta separacion. En origen
de viaje, el top 20% por crecimiento relativo aporta alrededor de `34.2%` del
aumento por cambio de share, mientras el top 20% por aporte concentra cerca de
`75.5%`. En residencia, la brecha es mayor: el top relativo aporta cerca de
`16.0%`, pero el top por aporte concentra cerca de `69.5%`. Por lo tanto, el
siguiente modelamiento debe distinguir explicitamente dos preguntas: explicar
heterogeneidad territorial de crecimiento QR, o explicar contribucion agregada
al aumento QR. La primera admite una lectura zonal con bajo o nulo peso por
volumen; la segunda requiere ponderar por soporte/volumen o modelar
directamente `share_shift_qr_delta`.

# 7) Bloque 4 - Variables candidatas

Este bloque vuelve a la pregunta de variables explicativas, pero todavia en
modo EDA. La pregunta no es que variable "causa" el crecimiento QR, sino que
familias de variables parecen alinearse con las diferencias interanuales entre
zonas.

La variable principal para este screening es `delta_relative_pp`: cuanto crece
la zona por sobre o bajo la tendencia global de su geografia. Tambien se revisa
`share_shift_qr_delta`, porque el bloque 3 mostro que tasa y aporte agregado
responden preguntas distintas.

## 7.2 Screening de variables candidatas

Cada fila de la tabla siguiente es una variable candidata. Las correlaciones
son descriptivas y se calculan por zona con soporte comparable. La columna
`partial_corr_delta_rel_control_share_2024` pregunta si la asociacion con el
crecimiento relativo se mantiene despues de controlar linealmente por el nivel
QR inicial en 2024, usando rangos tipo Spearman.

```{python}
#| label: block4b-candidate-screening-table

BLOCK4_MIN_ZONES = 30
BLOCK4_OUTCOME_COL = "delta_relative_pp"


def block4_log1p_winsor_z(series: pd.Series, p: float = 0.995) -> pd.Series:
    values = pd.to_numeric(series, errors="coerce").fillna(0).clip(lower=0)
    transformed = np.log1p(values)
    cap = transformed.quantile(p)
    transformed = transformed.clip(upper=cap)
    sd = transformed.std(ddof=0)
    if pd.isna(sd) or np.isclose(sd, 0):
        return pd.Series(0.0, index=series.index)
    return (transformed - transformed.mean()) / sd

def block4_collect_card_features() -> pd.DataFrame:
    schema_names = set(lf_cards.collect_schema().names())
    specs = [
        spec
        for spec in block4_card_feature_specs()
        if spec["zone_col"] in schema_names and spec["source_column"] in schema_names
    ]
    if not specs:
        return pd.DataFrame()

    rows = []
    spec_df = pd.DataFrame(specs)
    for (_, zone_col), group in spec_df.groupby(["geography_key", "zone_col"], sort=False):
        cols = group["source_column"].tolist()
        zone_values = (
            lf_cards
            .filter(pl.col(zone_col).is_not_null())
            .with_columns(pl.col(zone_col).cast(pl.Int64, strict=False).alias("zone_id"))
            .group_by("zone_id")
            .agg(
                [
                    pl.col(col).cast(pl.Float64, strict=False).median().alias(col)
                    for col in cols
                ]
            )
            .collect()
            .to_pandas()
            .replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        )
        for spec in group.to_dict("records"):
            col = spec["source_column"]
            one = zone_values[["zone_id", col]].rename(columns={col: "feature_value"})
            for key in [
                "geography_key",
                "geography",
                "family",
                "variable_label",
                "source_column",
                "feature_note",
                "scale_hint",
            ]:
                one[key] = spec[key]
            one["source_name"] = "matriz_tarjetas"
            rows.append(one)
    return pd.concat(rows, ignore_index=True) if rows else pd.DataFrame()


def block4_collect_zone_context_features(
    path: Path,
    specs: list[dict[str, str]],
    *,
    source_name: str,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    if not path.exists():
        return pd.DataFrame()
    lf = pl.scan_parquet(path)
    schema_names = set(lf.collect_schema().names())
    available = [spec for spec in specs if spec["source_column"] in schema_names]
    if not available or "zone_id" not in schema_names:
        return pd.DataFrame()

    agg_exprs = []
    for spec in available:
        col = spec["source_column"]
        if spec.get("aggregation", "mean") == "max":
            agg_exprs.append(pl.col(col).cast(pl.Float64, strict=False).max().alias(col))
        else:
            agg_exprs.append(pl.col(col).cast(pl.Float64, strict=False).mean().alias(col))

    zone_values = (
        lf
        .filter(pl.col("zone_id").is_not_null())
        .group_by("zone_id")
        .agg(agg_exprs)
        .collect()
        .to_pandas()
        .replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    )

    rows = []
    for spec in available:
        col = spec["source_column"]
        one = zone_values[["zone_id", col]].rename(columns={col: "feature_value"})
        if spec.get("fill_missing_origin_zones_zero", False):
            all_origin_zones = (
                zone_panel.loc[
                    zone_panel["geography_key"].eq("origin_trip"),
                    ["zone_id"],
                ]
                .drop_duplicates()
                .copy()
            )
            one = all_origin_zones.merge(one, on="zone_id", how="left")
            one["feature_value"] = one["feature_value"].fillna(0.0)
        one["geography_key"] = "origin_trip"
        one["geography"] = "Origen de viaje"
        one["family"] = spec["family"]
        one["variable_label"] = spec["variable_label"]
        one["source_column"] = col
        one["source_name"] = source_name
        one["feature_note"] = spec["feature_note"]
        one["scale_hint"] = spec.get("scale_hint", "percentil promedio")
        rows.append(one)
    return pd.concat(rows, ignore_index=True) if rows else pd.DataFrame()

            "source_column": "op_metro_demand_entries_zone_franja_week_percentile",
            "family": "Operacional Metro",
            "variable_label": "Metro | Demanda entradas zona-franja",
            "feature_note": "Percentil de entradas Metro observadas por zona-franja-semana.",
        },
        {

            "family": "Operacional Metro",
            "variable_label": "Metro | Oferta estacion-hora",
            "feature_note": "Percentil de trenes programados por estacion-hora en zona-franja.",
        },
        {
            "source_column": "op_metro_pressure_entries_per_scheduled_train_station_passage_zone_franja_week_percentile",
            "family": "Operacional Metro",
            "variable_label": "Metro | Presion demanda-oferta",
            "feature_note": "Percentil de entradas por pasada programada de tren; proxy operacional, no ocupacion real.",
        },
    ]

    frames = [
        block4_collect_zone_context_features(
            BLOCK4_OPERATIONAL_ZONE_PATH,
            bus_zone_specs,
            source_name="operational_zone_franja_week_context",
        ),
        block4_collect_zone_context_features(
            BLOCK4_OPERATIONAL_BUS_PRESSURE_PATH,
            bus_pressure_specs,
            source_name="operational_bus_zone_franja_week_pressure_context",
        ),
        block4_collect_zone_context_features(
            BLOCK4_OPERATIONAL_METRO_PATH,
            metro_specs,
            source_name="operational_metro_zone_franja_context",
        ),
    ]
    frames = [frame for frame in frames if not frame.empty]
    return pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True) if frames else pd.DataFrame()


def block4_safe_spearman(x: pd.Series, y: pd.Series) -> float:
    valid = x.notna() & y.notna()
    if valid.sum() < 3:
        return np.nan
    xv = x.loc[valid].astype(float)
    yv = y.loc[valid].astype(float)
    if xv.nunique(dropna=True) < 2 or yv.nunique(dropna=True) < 2:
        return np.nan
    return float(xv.corr(yv, method="spearman"))


def block4_weighted_pearson(x: pd.Series, y: pd.Series, w: pd.Series) -> float:
    valid = x.notna() & y.notna() & w.notna() & w.gt(0)
    if valid.sum() < 3:
        return np.nan
    xv = x.loc[valid].astype(float).to_numpy()
    yv = y.loc[valid].astype(float).to_numpy()
    wv = w.loc[valid].astype(float).to_numpy()
    if np.unique(xv).size < 2 or np.unique(yv).size < 2:
        return np.nan
    x_mean = np.average(xv, weights=wv)
    y_mean = np.average(yv, weights=wv)
    cov = np.average((xv - x_mean) * (yv - y_mean), weights=wv)
    x_var = np.average((xv - x_mean) ** 2, weights=wv)
    y_var = np.average((yv - y_mean) ** 2, weights=wv)
    if x_var <= 0 or y_var <= 0:
        return np.nan
    return float(cov / np.sqrt(x_var * y_var))


def block4_partial_spearman(x: pd.Series, y: pd.Series, control: pd.Series) -> float:
    valid = x.notna() & y.notna() & control.notna()
    if valid.sum() < 5:
        return np.nan
    tmp = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "x": x.loc[valid].astype(float),
            "y": y.loc[valid].astype(float),
            "control": control.loc[valid].astype(float),
        }
    )
    if tmp.nunique(dropna=True).min() < 2:
        return np.nan
    x_rank = tmp["x"].rank(method="average").to_numpy()
    y_rank = tmp["y"].rank(method="average").to_numpy()
    c_rank = tmp["control"].rank(method="average").to_numpy()
    design = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(tmp)), c_rank])
    x_resid = x_rank - design @ np.linalg.lstsq(design, x_rank, rcond=None)[0]
    y_resid = y_rank - design @ np.linalg.lstsq(design, y_rank, rcond=None)[0]
    if np.isclose(x_resid.var(), 0) or np.isclose(y_resid.var(), 0):
        return np.nan
    return float(np.corrcoef(x_resid, y_resid)[0, 1])


def block4_q5_q1(feature: pd.Series, outcome: pd.Series) -> float:
    valid = feature.notna() & outcome.notna()
    if valid.sum() < 10:
        return np.nan
    tmp = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "feature": feature.loc[valid].astype(float),
            "outcome": outcome.loc[valid].astype(float),
        }
    )
    if tmp["feature"].nunique(dropna=True) < 2:
        return np.nan
    tmp["feature_quintile"] = pd.qcut(
        tmp["feature"].rank(method="first"),
        q=5,
        labels=[1, 2, 3, 4, 5],
    ).astype(int)
    q1 = tmp.loc[tmp["feature_quintile"].eq(1), "outcome"].mean()
    q5 = tmp.loc[tmp["feature_quintile"].eq(5), "outcome"].mean()
    return float(q5 - q1)


def block4_signal_hint(row: pd.Series) -> str:
    partial = abs(row["partial_corr_delta_rel_control_share_2024"]) if pd.notna(row["partial_corr_delta_rel_control_share_2024"]) else 0
    weighted = abs(row["weighted_pearson_delta_relative_pp"]) if pd.notna(row["weighted_pearson_delta_relative_pp"]) else 0
    level = abs(row["spearman_level_2024"]) if pd.notna(row["spearman_level_2024"]) else 0
    if max(partial, weighted, level) < 0.10:
        return "Senal baja"
    if partial >= 0.15:
        return "Candidata para crecimiento relativo"
    if weighted >= 0.20:
        return "Candidata ponderada por soporte"
    if level >= 0.25:
        return "Mas nivel inicial que cambio"
    return "Senal descriptiva moderada"


def block4_screen_features(feature_values: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    if feature_values.empty:
        return pd.DataFrame()

    supported = zone_panel.loc[
        zone_panel["support_min"].ge(BASE_MIN_SUPPORT),
        [
            "zone_id",
            "geography_key",
            "geography",
            "support_min",
            "qr_share_2024",
            "delta_pp",
            "delta_relative_pp",
            "share_shift_qr_delta",
        ],
    ].copy()

    metadata_cols = [
        "geography_key",
        "geography",
        "family",
        "variable_label",
        "source_column",
        "source_name",
        "feature_note",
        "scale_hint",
    ]
    rows = []
    for metadata, values in feature_values.groupby(metadata_cols, dropna=False):
        spec = dict(zip(metadata_cols, metadata))
        geo_supported = supported.loc[
            supported["geography_key"].eq(spec["geography_key"])
        ].copy()
        if geo_supported.empty:
            continue
        tmp = geo_supported.merge(
            values[["zone_id", "feature_value"]].drop_duplicates("zone_id"),
            on="zone_id",
            how="left",
        ).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        valid = tmp["feature_value"].notna()
        n_valid = int(valid.sum())
        if n_valid < BLOCK4_MIN_ZONES:
            continue
        rows.append(
            {
                **spec,
                "n_zones_supported": len(geo_supported),
                "n_zones_with_feature": n_valid,
                "coverage_zones": n_valid / len(geo_supported),
                "feature_p10": tmp.loc[valid, "feature_value"].quantile(0.10),
                "feature_p50": tmp.loc[valid, "feature_value"].median(),
                "feature_p90": tmp.loc[valid, "feature_value"].quantile(0.90),
                "spearman_level_2024": block4_safe_spearman(
                    tmp["feature_value"],
                    tmp["qr_share_2024"],
                ),
                "spearman_delta_relative_pp": block4_safe_spearman(
                    tmp["feature_value"],
                    tmp["delta_relative_pp"],
                ),
                "weighted_pearson_delta_relative_pp": block4_weighted_pearson(
                    tmp["feature_value"],
                    tmp["delta_relative_pp"],
                    tmp["support_min"],
                ),
                "partial_corr_delta_rel_control_share_2024": block4_partial_spearman(
                    tmp["feature_value"],
                    tmp["delta_relative_pp"],
                    tmp["qr_share_2024"],
                ),
                "q5_q1_delta_relative_pp": block4_q5_q1(
                    tmp["feature_value"],
                    tmp["delta_relative_pp"],
                ),
                "spearman_share_shift_qr_delta": block4_safe_spearman(
                    tmp["feature_value"],
                    tmp["share_shift_qr_delta"],
                ),
            }
        )

    if not rows:
        return pd.DataFrame()
    out = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    out["signal_score"] = out[
        [
            "spearman_delta_relative_pp",
            "weighted_pearson_delta_relative_pp",
            "partial_corr_delta_rel_control_share_2024",
        ]
    ].abs().max(axis=1)
    out["signal_hint"] = out.apply(block4_signal_hint, axis=1)
    return out.sort_values(
        ["geography", "signal_score", "family", "variable_label"],
        ascending=[True, False, True, True],
    ).reset_index(drop=True)


block4_feature_values = pd.concat(
    [
        block4_collect_card_features(),
        block4_build_osm_zone_features(),
        block4_collect_operational_features(),
    ],
    ignore_index=True,
)

block4_feature_screening = block4_screen_features(block4_feature_values)

display(
    style_table(
        block4_feature_screening[
            [
                "geography",
                "family",
                "variable_label",
                "n_zones_with_feature",
                "coverage_zones",
                "spearman_level_2024",
                "spearman_delta_relative_pp",
                "partial_corr_delta_rel_control_share_2024",
                "q5_q1_delta_relative_pp",
                "weighted_pearson_delta_relative_pp",
                "spearman_share_shift_qr_delta",
                "signal_hint",
            ]
        ],
        {
            "n_zones_with_feature": fmt_int,
            "coverage_zones": fmt_pct,
            "spearman_level_2024": "{:+.2f}",
            "spearman_delta_relative_pp": "{:+.2f}",
            "partial_corr_delta_rel_control_share_2024": "{:+.2f}",
            "q5_q1_delta_relative_pp": "{:+.2f}",
            "weighted_pearson_delta_relative_pp": "{:+.2f}",
            "spearman_share_shift_qr_delta": "{:+.2f}",
        },
    )
)
```

## 7.3 Resumen por familia

Esta tabla comprime la lectura por familia. `max_signal_score` no es un ranking
causal: solo toma la asociacion descriptiva mas fuerte de cada familia con el
crecimiento relativo, usando las medidas de screening anteriores.

```{python}
#| label: block4c-family-signal-summary
print("label: block4c-family-signal-summary")

block4_family_summary = (
    block4_feature_screening
    .assign(abs_partial=lambda frame: frame["partial_corr_delta_rel_control_share_2024"].abs())
    .assign(abs_weighted=lambda frame: frame["weighted_pearson_delta_relative_pp"].abs())
    .assign(abs_spearman_delta=lambda frame: frame["spearman_delta_relative_pp"].abs())
    .groupby(["geography", "family"], as_index=False)
    .agg(
        n_variables=("variable_label", "nunique"),
        max_signal_score=("signal_score", "max"),
        median_abs_partial=("abs_partial", "median"),
        median_abs_weighted=("abs_weighted", "median"),
        median_abs_spearman_delta=("abs_spearman_delta", "median"),
        top_variable=("variable_label", lambda values: values.iloc[0]),
    )
    .sort_values(["geography", "max_signal_score"], ascending=[True, False])
)

def plot_block4_family_summary(summary_df: pd.DataFrame) -> None:
    if summary_df.empty:
        return
    geographies = ["Residencia", "Origen de viaje"]
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(
        1,
        2,
        figsize=(14, 5.2),
        facecolor=FIG_BG,
        constrained_layout=False,
    )
    for ax, geography in zip(axes, geographies):
        panel = summary_df.loc[summary_df["geography"].eq(geography)].copy()
        panel = panel.sort_values("max_signal_score", ascending=True)
        y = np.arange(len(panel))
        colors = np.where(panel["max_signal_score"].ge(0.20), PAYMENT_COLORS["QR"], "#91A7A0")
        ax.barh(y, panel["max_signal_score"], color=colors, alpha=0.86)
        ax.set_yticks(y)
        ax.set_yticklabels(panel["family"])
        ax.set_xlim(0, max(0.35, summary_df["max_signal_score"].max() * 1.15))
        ax.set_xlabel("Max. asociacion descriptiva con crecimiento relativo")
        ax.set_title(
            geography,
            loc="left",
            fontsize=12,
            fontweight="bold",
            color=TEXT_COLOR,
        )
        style_axis(ax, grid_axis="x")
    fig.suptitle(
        "Senal descriptiva por familia de variables candidatas",
        fontsize=16,
        fontweight="bold",
        color=TEXT_COLOR,
        y=0.98,
    )
    fig.text(
        0.5,
        0.92,
        "Mayor valor indica mayor asociacion con delta zonal - global; no es modelo causal.",
        ha="center",
        fontsize=10,
        color=MUTED_TEXT,
    )
    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.18, right=0.98, top=0.82, bottom=0.15, wspace=0.42)
    plt.show()


plot_block4_family_summary(block4_family_summary)
```

## 7.4 Macrozonas como geografia base

La macrozona no es una "variable explicativa" individual. Sirve como contexto
base: si una variable candidata solo replica diferencias Centro/Oriente versus
Sur/Poniente, entonces su lectura debe hacerse con cuidado antes de llevarla a
una regresion.

```{python}
#| label: block4d-macrozone-base-screening
print("label: block4d-macrozone-base-screening")

if "block3_zone_contrib" not in globals():

    block3_zone_contrib = build_block3_zone_contribution_panel(
        zone_panel,
        zona777_geometries,

    block3_zone_contrib
    .loc[block3_zone_contrib["has_delta_support"]]
    .groupby(["geography", "macrozone_group"], as_index=False)
    .agg(
        n_zones=("zone_id", "nunique"),
        support_min_median=("support_min", "median"),
        qr_share_2024_median=("qr_share_2024", "median"),
        delta_relative_pp_median=("delta_relative_pp", "median"),

)

display(

            "qr_share_2024_median": fmt_pct,
            "delta_relative_pp_median": fmt_pp,

            "share_shift_qr_delta": signed_int_label,
            "share_of_share_shift_total": fmt_pct,
        },

)
```

**Lectura esperada del bloque 4.** Este screening debe leerse como una tabla
de priorizacion. Las variables con señal en `delta_relative_pp` pueden avanzar
a visualizaciones bivariadas o a especificaciones de regresion. Las variables
con señal fuerte solo en `share_shift_qr_delta` probablemente reflejan volumen
o centralidad operacional. Las variables de carga BIP funcionan como control
negativo: si siguen mostrando señal baja, refuerzan la lectura de que el
crecimiento QR no se explica principalmente por falta de acceso fisico a carga.

# 8) Bloque 5 - Screening bivariado

Este bloque toma las variables candidatas del bloque anterior y las mira contra
el outcome principal: `delta_relative_pp`, es decir, crecimiento QR zonal por
sobre o bajo la tendencia global de su geografia. La meta no es elegir todavia
un modelo final, sino identificar que relaciones simples vale la pena llevar a
un diagnostico pre-modelo.

```{python}
def block5_reading_hint(row: pd.Series) -> str:
    if row.get("plot_group") == "Control BIP":
        return "Control / senal baja"

    rel = abs(row["spearman_delta_relative_pp"]) if pd.notna(row["spearman_delta_relative_pp"]) else 0
    weighted = abs(row["weighted_pearson_delta_relative_pp"]) if pd.notna(row["weighted_pearson_delta_relative_pp"]) else 0
    partial = abs(row["partial_corr_delta_rel_control_share_2024"]) if pd.notna(row["partial_corr_delta_rel_control_share_2024"]) else 0
    q5_q1 = abs(row["q5_q1_delta_relative_pp"]) if pd.notna(row["q5_q1_delta_relative_pp"]) else 0
    shift = abs(row["spearman_share_shift_qr_delta"]) if pd.notna(row["spearman_share_shift_qr_delta"]) else 0

    if max(rel, weighted, partial, q5_q1) < 0.10 and shift < 0.25:
        return "Control / senal baja"
    if partial >= 0.15 or (rel >= 0.18 and weighted >= 0.20) or q5_q1 >= 0.85:
        return "Crecimiento relativo"
    if shift >= 0.35 and max(rel, partial) < 0.12:
        return "Aporte / volumen"
    if shift >= 0.35:
        return "Mixta: tasa y aporte"
    return "Senal moderada"

            "rho aporte share": "{:+.2f}",
        },
    )
)
```

## 8.2 Gradientes por quintil

Cada variable se divide en quintiles dentro de su geografia. El eje vertical de
la figura es el promedio de `delta_relative_pp`: cero significa crecer igual
que la tendencia global, valores positivos indican crecimiento sobre tendencia
y valores negativos indican crecimiento bajo tendencia.

```{python}
#| label: block5b-candidate-quintile-gradients
print("label: block5b-candidate-quintile-gradients")


def block5_selected_feature_values() -> pd.DataFrame:
    if block4_feature_values.empty or block5_selected_specs.empty:
        return pd.DataFrame()
    return (
        block4_feature_values
        .merge(
            block5_selected_specs,
            on=["geography_key", "source_column"],
            how="inner",
        )
        .copy()
    )


def build_block5_quintile_gradients(feature_values: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    if feature_values.empty:
        return pd.DataFrame()

    supported = zone_panel.loc[
        zone_panel["support_min"].ge(BASE_MIN_SUPPORT),
        [
            "zone_id",
            "geography_key",
            "geography",
            "support_min",
            "qr_share_2024",
            "qr_share_2025",
            "delta_pp",
            "delta_relative_pp",
            "share_shift_qr_delta",
        ],
    ].copy()

    group_cols = [
        "geography_key",
        "geography",
        "plot_group",
        "plot_label",
        "plot_role",
        "plot_order",
        "source_column",
        "scale_hint",
    ]
    rows = []
    for metadata, values in feature_values.groupby(group_cols, dropna=False, sort=False):
        spec = dict(zip(group_cols, metadata))
        geo_supported = supported.loc[
            supported["geography_key"].eq(spec["geography_key"])
        ].copy()
        tmp = geo_supported.merge(
            values[["zone_id", "feature_value"]].drop_duplicates("zone_id"),
            on="zone_id",
            how="left",
        ).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        valid = tmp["feature_value"].notna() & tmp["delta_relative_pp"].notna()
        if valid.sum() < 30 or tmp.loc[valid, "feature_value"].nunique(dropna=True) < 2:
            continue
        tmp = tmp.loc[valid].copy()
        tmp["feature_quintile"] = pd.qcut(
            tmp["feature_value"].rank(method="first"),
            q=5,
            labels=[1, 2, 3, 4, 5],
        ).astype(int)
        summary = (
            tmp
            .groupby("feature_quintile", as_index=False)
            .agg(
                n_zones=("zone_id", "nunique"),
                support_min_median=("support_min", "median"),
                feature_median=("feature_value", "median"),
                qr_share_2024_mean=("qr_share_2024", "mean"),
                qr_share_2025_mean=("qr_share_2025", "mean"),
                delta_pp_mean=("delta_pp", "mean"),
                delta_relative_pp_mean=("delta_relative_pp", "mean"),
                delta_relative_pp_median=("delta_relative_pp", "median"),
                share_shift_qr_delta_sum=("share_shift_qr_delta", "sum"),
            )
        )
        for key, value in spec.items():
            summary[key] = value
        rows.append(summary)

    if not rows:
        return pd.DataFrame()
    out = pd.concat(rows, ignore_index=True)
    out["quintile_label"] = out["feature_quintile"].map(
        {1: "Q1\nmenor", 2: "Q2", 3: "Q3", 4: "Q4", 5: "Q5\nmayor"}
    )
    return out.sort_values(["plot_order", "feature_quintile"])


def plot_block5_quintile_gradients(gradient_df: pd.DataFrame) -> None:
    if gradient_df.empty:
        return
    specs = (
        gradient_df[
            [
                "geography",
                "plot_group",
                "plot_label",
                "plot_order",
                "source_column",
            ]
        ]
        .drop_duplicates()
        .sort_values("plot_order")
        .to_dict("records")
    )
    n_cols = 3
    n_rows = int(np.ceil(len(specs) / n_cols))
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(
        n_rows,
        n_cols,
        figsize=(15.5, max(4.3, 3.0 * n_rows)),
        facecolor=FIG_BG,
        squeeze=False,
    )
    colors = {
        "Residencia": PAYMENT_COLORS["QR"],
        "Origen de viaje": PAYMENT_COLORS["BIP"],
    }
    for ax, spec in zip(axes.flat, specs):
        panel = gradient_df.loc[
            gradient_df["geography"].eq(spec["geography"])
            & gradient_df["source_column"].eq(spec["source_column"])
        ].sort_values("feature_quintile")
        color = colors.get(spec["geography"], TEXT_COLOR)
        ax.plot(
            panel["feature_quintile"],
            panel["delta_relative_pp_mean"],
            color=color,
            marker="o",
            linewidth=1.7,
            markersize=4.8,
        )
        ax.axhline(0, color=MUTED_TEXT, linestyle="--", linewidth=0.9, alpha=0.8)
        ax.set_xticks([1, 2, 3, 4, 5])
        ax.set_xticklabels(["Q1\nmenor", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4", "Q5\nmayor"], fontsize=8.4)
        ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(FuncFormatter(lambda value, _pos: f"{value:+.1f}"))
        ax.set_title(
            f"{spec['plot_group']} | {spec['plot_label']}",
            loc="left",
            fontsize=10.4,
            fontweight="bold",
            color=TEXT_COLOR,
            pad=7,
        )
        ax.set_ylabel("Delta relativo (pp)")
        style_axis(ax, grid_axis="y")
    for ax in axes.flat[len(specs):]:
        ax.set_visible(False)

    fig.suptitle(
        "Gradientes de crecimiento QR por quintil de variables candidatas",
        fontsize=16.2,
        fontweight="bold",
        color=TEXT_COLOR,
        y=0.99,
    )
    fig.text(
        0.5,
        0.955,
        "Cada panel ordena zonas en quintiles de la variable. Eje Y: delta zonal - delta global.",
        ha="center",
        fontsize=9.8,
        color=MUTED_TEXT,
    )
    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.06, right=0.985, top=0.90, bottom=0.08, hspace=0.48, wspace=0.28)
    plt.show()


block5_feature_values = block5_selected_feature_values()
```
